name: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
credit: Imagined likeness of Kakinomoto no Hitomaro by Kano Tan'yu, from the Sanjurokkasen-gaku (17th century); no contemporary portrait exists · Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)
bio: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro was a court poet of the late Asuka period and is regarded as the greatest poet of the Man'yoshu, the oldest anthology of Japanese poetry. Little is certain about his life beyond what his poems suggest: he served at the courts of the Empress Jito and the Emperor Mommu, wrote ceremonial laments and praise-poems for members of the imperial house, and is thought to have died in the province of Iwami. He is the first of the later Thirty-Six Immortals of Poetry.

These five poems come from Clara A. Walsh's The Master-Singers of Japan (1910), where he appears as Hitomaro, Kakinomoto no Asomi. They are English verse renderings made for a general audience: Walsh turns the long poems (choka) and their envoys (hanka) into rhymed English stanzas, and her versions are not literal.

poems.title: On the Death of His Wife
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: The Master-Singers of Japan
poems.text:
When hand in hand, we two did wend
Adown the paths of Life our way,
And from the dike's ridge yonder, gazed
On the dense elm-trees' green array,
From out whose leafy canopy,
Glimpsed here and there, our cottage eaves;
Then were our tender thoughts of love,
Frequent as are the fresh spring leaves
Upon the tangled boughs.

Leaning on thee; my very soul
Rested in perfect trust on thee.
Sad is the doom that none may shun,
Mournful the fate that none may flee!
Over the far-flung purple moor,
'Midst the white funeral banners borne,
Slowly they take thee, thou who rose
With the wild-fowl at break of dawn,
And they must hide thee far away,
As sunset-hills hide out the day.
Thy little son, a memory
Of thy dear self, weeps bitter tears,
And seeks for comfort in my arms.
I fondle him, to soothe his fears;
But with a man's unskilful hand,
Lacking the tender touch that cheers.
Our chamber, now so desolate,
Where once all close our pillows lay!
The night is filled with loneliness,
And sorrow darkens all the day.
I know thou sleepest on the hill
Of the cock-crowing, but in vain
I climb its steep and stony heights,
Nor one dim moment shall again
On her, who living, I loved best
These eyes of mine adoring rest!
Homewards I turn, and in our lonely room,
Without the alcove, in the silent gloom
My gaze falls on thy pillow!

Still the fair moon illumes the Autumn night,
As when last year we marvelled at its light,
But between thee and me, a year's whole space,
That one past year divideth!

poems.title: On Prince Naga's Going A-Hunting on the Moor of Kariji
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: The Master-Singers of Japan
poems.text:
My Prince, who rules in peaceful power,
Child of the Sun-orb shining high,
Hath ta'en his horses and his men
To where the stag and wild-fowl lie.
On wild Kariji's grassy moor,
He setteth forth to chase the deer.
As the stag boweth—knees to ground,
So do I, bowing low, revere;
As the quail creepeth through the grass,
I tender service to my Lord,
Lifting mine eyes as to the sky,
Sun-bright and shining as a sword—
Eyes like a polished mirror bright,
Loyal and true—reflect the light.
Is he not brave, my Prince! and fair
As the Spring-blossoms, debonair!

See how the Hunter's Moon, full-orbed,
Crosseth the heavens with shining light;
We will draw down the moon with cords,
To form his canopy to-night.

poems.title: On Prince Karu's Retirement to the Moor of Aki, to Meditate
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: The Master-Singers of Japan
poems.text:
He, Heaven-descended of the Shining One
Who dwells divine, bright Goddess of the Sun!
He hath forsaken circumstance and state
Of royal cities, and, unhesitate,
Hátsusé's hill-encircled wilds reviews,
The pathless steeps, the forest ways pursues—
When morning dawns, with waking wild-birds' cry,
When in the West the burning sun-fires die,
Faring; till on the moor of Aki, white
With fallen snow, the grasses tall and slight
Of plumed susuki, brusheth he aside,
To sleep on the grass-pillow, there to bide.
And, far from pageantry and regal state
On the past days to muse and meditate!

poems.title: On Parting from His Wife
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: The Master-Singers of Japan
poems.text:
Not yet, O Hill! high hill of Autumn scatter
Red leaves and gold athwart the distant view.
Let me gaze on, a little instant longer,
Where she I love leans toward me through the blue!

poems.title: On the Death of His Wife at Karu
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: The Master-Singers of Japan
poems.text:
By Karu's road, where high the mallard fly,
In her own home-place did my love abide,
And all my soul with deep desire did sigh
To see her and to linger by her side.
But prying eyes too constant visits barred,
And eyes too many made our meetings few.
Yet did I trust—tho' long the ways and hard,
Endless as trailing creepers—yet anew
To meet my love. All hopeful did I trust,
As to his tall ship trusteth seaman bold,
While still our love was hid, as deep pool thrust
'Mid rocks whose hearts hold fire, tho' outward cold.

Alas! the sun is darkened in my sky!
The moon that lit my heav'n is hid from view.
Graceful as sea-fronds that in green deeps lie,
My love, like Autumn's pride of leaf and hue,
Out of my world has vanished, as the dew!

Such are the tidings that the runner brings,
White-wanded messenger whose words I hear—
They pierce me, as the arrows from the strings
Of white-wood bows—the words that sting and sear!

Nor answer find I, neither comfort gain.
Yet, to assuage a thousandth part my woe,
Karu-wards wending, full of grief and pain,
I listen for her accents sweet and low,
Her voice I list for—but alone I hear
The wild-fowl screaming as they take their flight
Across Unebi, to the shining mere.
No form with sleeves uplifted greets my sight—
The thronging folk upon the way I meet,
Scanning their faces, but I never see
A face like hers—and so with weary feet
I stumble on in hopeless misery.
Onward I wend, and can but cry again
The loved one's name, and wave my sleeve in vain!

Fain would I seek among the winding hill paths,
Where ruddy clouds of foliage hide the ways,
Her whom I love, who wanders ever further;
But all unknown the pathway where she strays!

poems.title: Long is the mountain pheasant’s tail
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 3
poems.text:
Long is the mountain pheasant’s tail
That curves down in its flight;
But longer still, it seems to me,
Left in my lonely plight,
Is this unending night.

poems.title: 3. 足引きの 山鳥の尾の しだり尾の (Ashibiki no yamadori no o no shidario no)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 拾遺集
poems.text:
足引きの 山鳥の尾の しだり尾の
ながながし夜を ひとりかもねむ

poems.title: MYS 30: 楽浪の志賀の辛崎 (Sasanami no Shiga no Karasaki)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 近江の荒れたる都を過く時、柿本朝臣人麿がよめる歌 (envoy, 反歌)
poems.text: 楽浪の志賀の辛崎幸くあれど大宮人の船待ちかねつ

poems.title: MYS 31: 楽浪の志賀の大曲 (Sasanami no Shiga no Ōwada)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 近江の荒れたる都を過く時、柿本朝臣人麿がよめる歌
poems.text: 楽浪の志賀の大曲淀むとも昔の人にまたも逢はめやも

poems.title: MYS 39: 山川も依りて仕ふる (Yamakawa mo yorite tsukauru)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 吉野の宮に幸せる時、柿本朝臣人麿がよめる歌 (envoy, 反歌)
poems.text: 山川も依りて仕ふる神ながらたぎつ河内に船出せすかも

poems.title: MYS 40: 嗚呼児の浦に船乗りすらむ (Ago no ura ni funanori suramu)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 伊勢国に幸せる時の歌. 左注: 柿本朝臣人麿が京に留りてよめる歌 (the three poems 40-42).
poems.text: 嗚呼児の浦に船乗りすらむ乙女らが珠裳の裾に潮満つらむか

poems.title: MYS 42: 潮騒に伊良虞の島辺 (Shiosai ni Irago no shimabe)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 伊勢国に幸せる時の歌. 左注: 柿本朝臣人麿が京に留りてよめる歌 (the three poems 40-42).
poems.text: 潮騒に伊良虞の島辺榜ぐ船に妹乗るらむか荒き島廻を

poems.title: MYS 46: 安騎の野に宿れる旅人 (Aki no no ni yadoreru tabito)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 輕皇子の安騎の野に宿りませる時、柿本朝臣人麿がよめる歌 (envoy, 反歌)
poems.text: 安騎の野に宿れる旅人うち靡き寝も寝らめやもいにしへ思ふに

poems.title: MYS 48: 東の野に炎の (Higashi no no ni kagiroi no)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 輕皇子の安騎の野に宿りませる時、柿本朝臣人麿がよめる歌
poems.text: 東の野に炎の立つ見えて反り見すれば月かたぶきぬ

poems.title: MYS 49: 日並の皇子の命の (Hinamishi no miko no mikoto no)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 輕皇子の安騎の野に宿りませる時、柿本朝臣人麿がよめる歌
poems.text: 日並の皇子の命の馬並めて御狩立たしし時は来向ふ

poems.title: MYS 132: 石見のや高角山の (Iwami no ya Takatsunoyama no)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麿が石見国より妻に別れ上来る時の歌二首、また短歌 (envoy, 反歌)
poems.text: 石見のや高角山の木の間より我が振る袖を妹見つらむか

poems.title: MYS 133: 小竹が葉はみ山もさやに (Sasa ga ha wa miyama mo sayani)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麿が石見国より妻に別れ上来る時の歌二首、また短歌
poems.text: 小竹が葉はみ山もさやに乱れども吾は妹思ふ別れ来ぬれば

poems.title: MYS 136: 青駒が足掻を速み (Aokoma ga agaki o hayami)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麿が石見国より妻に別れ上来る時の歌二首、また短歌 (envoy, 反歌)
poems.text: 青駒が足掻を速み雲居にそ妹があたりを過ぎて来にける

poems.title: MYS 169: あかねさす日は照らせれど (Akane sasu hi wa teraseredo)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 日並皇子の尊の殯宮の時、柿本朝臣人麿がよめる歌一首、また短歌
poems.text: あかねさす日は照らせれどぬば玉の夜渡る月の隠らく惜しも

poems.title: MYS 195: 敷布の袖交へし君 (Shikitae no sode kaeshi kimi)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 河島皇子の殯宮の時、柿本朝臣人麿が泊瀬部皇女に献れる歌一首、また短歌 (envoy, 反歌)
poems.text: 敷布の袖交へし君玉垂の越智野に過ぎぬまたも逢はめやも

poems.title: MYS 208: 秋山の黄葉を茂み (Akiyama no momichi o shigemi)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麿が、妻の死りし後、泣血哀慟よめる歌二首、また短歌 (envoy, 反歌)
poems.text: 秋山の黄葉を茂み惑はせる妹を求めむ山道知らずも

poems.title: MYS 218: 楽浪の志賀津の子らが (Sasanami no Shigatsu no ko ra ga)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 志賀津釆女が死れる時、柿本朝臣人麿がよめる歌一首、また短歌 (envoy, 反歌)
poems.text: 楽浪の志賀津の子らが罷りにし川瀬の道を見れば寂しも

poems.title: MYS 221: 妻もあらば摘みて食げまし (Tsuma mo araba tsumite tagemashi)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 讃岐国狭岑島にて石中の死人を視て、柿本朝臣人麿がよめる歌一首、また短歌 (envoy, 反歌)
poems.text: 妻もあらば摘みて食げまし狭岑山野の上のうはぎ過ぎにけらずや

poems.title: MYS 223: 鴨山の磐根し枕ける (Kamoyama no iwane shi makeru)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麿が石見国に在りて死らむとする時、自傷みよめる歌一首
poems.text: 鴨山の磐根し枕ける吾をかも知らにと妹が待ちつつあらむ

poems.title: MYS 235: 皇は神にしませば (Ōkimi wa kami ni shimaseba)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 雑歌 / 天皇の雷岳に御遊せる時、柿本朝臣人麻呂がよめる歌一首
poems.text: 皇は神にしませば天雲の雷の上に廬りせるかも

poems.title: MYS 250: 玉藻刈る敏馬を過ぎ (Tamamo karu Minume o sugi)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麻呂が覊旅の歌八首
poems.text: 玉藻刈る敏馬を過ぎ夏草の野島の崎に舟近づきぬ

poems.title: MYS 253: 稲日野も行き過ぎかてに (Inabino mo yukisugikate ni)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麻呂が覊旅の歌八首
poems.text: 稲日野も行き過ぎかてに思へれば心恋しき加古の島見ゆ

poems.title: MYS 254: 燭火の明石大門に (Tomoshibi no Akashi no Ōto ni)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麻呂が覊旅の歌八首
poems.text: 燭火の明石大門に入らむ日や榜ぎ別れなむ家のあたり見ず

poems.title: MYS 255: 天ざかる夷の長道ゆ (Amazakaru hina no nagachi yu)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麻呂が覊旅の歌八首
poems.text: 天ざかる夷の長道ゆ恋ひ来れば明石の門より大和島見ゆ

poems.title: MYS 262: 矢釣山木立も見えず (Yatsuriyama kodachi mo miezu)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麻呂が新田部皇子に献れる歌一首、また短歌 (envoy, 反歌)
poems.text: 矢釣山木立も見えず降り乱る雪に騒きて参らくよしも

poems.title: MYS 264: 物部の八十宇治川の (Mononofu no yasoujigawa no)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麻呂が近江国より上来る時、宇治河の辺に至りてよめる歌一首
poems.text: 物部の八十宇治川の網代木にいさよふ波の行方知らずも

poems.title: MYS 266: 淡海の海夕波千鳥 (Ōmi no umi yūnami chidori)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麻呂が歌一首
poems.text: 淡海の海夕波千鳥汝が鳴けば心もしぬに古思ほゆ

poems.title: MYS 430: 八雲さす出雲の子らが (Yakumo sasu Izumo no ko ra ga)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: 題詞: 溺れ死ねる出雲娘子を吉野に火葬れる時、柿本朝臣人麿がよめる歌二首
poems.text: 八雲さす出雲の子らが黒髪は吉野の川の沖になづさふ

poems.title: MYS 1087: 穴師川川波立ちぬ (Anashigawa kawanami tachinu)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain. 題詞: 雲を詠める
poems.text: 穴師川川波立ちぬ巻向の弓月が岳に雲居立つらし

poems.title: MYS 1088: あしひきの山河の瀬の (Ashihiki no yamakawa no se no)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: あしひきの山河の瀬の鳴るなべに弓月が岳に雲立ち渡る

poems.title: MYS 1101: ぬば玉の夜さり来れば (Nubatama no yosari kureba)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: ぬば玉の夜さり来れば巻向の川音高しも嵐かも疾き

poems.title: MYS 1118: 古にありけむ人も (Inishie ni arikemu hito mo)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain. 題詞: 葉を詠める
poems.text: 古にありけむ人も吾がごとか三輪の桧原に挿頭折りけむ

poems.title: MYS 1269: 巻向の山辺響みて (Makimuku no yamabe toyomite)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 巻向の山辺響みて行く水の水沫の如し世の人吾等は

poems.title: MYS 1285: 春日すら田に立ち疲る (Haruhi sura ta ni tachitsukaru)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 春日すら田に立ち疲る君は悲しも若草の妻なき君が田に立ち疲る

poems.title: MYS 1709: 御食向ふ南淵山の (Mikemukau Minabuchiyama no)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain. 題詞: 弓削皇子に献れる歌一首
poems.text: 御食向ふ南淵山の巌には降りしはだれか消え残りたる

poems.title: MYS 1775: 泊瀬川夕渡り来て (Hatsusegawa yūwatari kite)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 泊瀬川夕渡り来て我妹子が家の金門に近づきにけり

poems.title: MYS 1797: 潮気立つ荒磯にはあれど (Shioke tatsu ariso ni wa aredo)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 潮気立つ荒磯にはあれど行く水の過ぎにし妹が形見とぞ来し

poems.title: MYS 1812: 久かたの天の香具山 (Hisakata no ame no Kaguyama)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain. 題詞: 春の雑歌 / 雑歌
poems.text: 久かたの天の香具山この夕へ霞たなびく春立つらしも

poems.title: MYS 1818: 子らが名に懸けのよろしき (Kora ga na ni kake no yoroshiki)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 子らが名に懸けのよろしき朝妻の片山崖に霞たなびく

poems.title: MYS 2313: あしひきの山かも高き (Ashihiki no yama kamo takaki)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: あしひきの山かも高き巻向の崖の小松にみ雪降りけり

poems.title: MYS 2314: 巻向の桧原もいまだ (Makimuku no hibara mo imada)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 巻向の桧原もいまだ雲居ねば小松が末ゆ沫雪流る

poems.title: MYS 2315: あしひきの山道も知らず (Ashihiki no yamaji mo shirazu)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: あしひきの山道も知らず白橿の枝もとををに雪の降れれば

poems.title: MYS 2352: 新室を踏み鎮む子が (Niimuro o fumishizumu ko ga)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 新室を踏み鎮む子が手玉鳴らすも玉のごと照らせる君を内へと申せ

poems.title: MYS 2353: 泊瀬の斎槻がもとに (Hatsuse no yutsuki ga moto ni)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 泊瀬の斎槻がもとに吾が隠せる妻あかねさし照れる月夜に人見てむかも

poems.title: MYS 2355: 息の緒に吾が思ふ妹は (Iki no o ni a ga omou imo wa)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 息の緒に吾が思ふ妹は早も死ねやも生けりとも吾に寄るべしと人の言はなくに

poems.title: MYS 2357: 朝戸出の君が足結を (Asatode no kimi ga ayui o)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 朝戸出の君が足結を濡らす露原早く起きて出でつつ吾も裳の裾濡れな

poems.title: MYS 2368: たらちねの母が手離れ (Tarachine no haha ga tabanare)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain. 題詞: 正に心緒を述ぶ
poems.text: たらちねの母が手離れかくばかりすべなきことはいまだせなくに

poems.title: MYS 2369: 人の寝る味寐は寝ずて (Hito no nuru umai wa nezute)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 人の寝る味寐は寝ずてはしきやし君が目すらを欲りて嘆くも

poems.title: MYS 2394: 朝影に我が身はなりぬ (Asakage ni a ga mi wa narinu)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 朝影に我が身はなりぬ玉かぎるほのかに見えて去にし子ゆゑに

poems.title: MYS 2395: 行けど行けど逢はぬ妹ゆゑ (Yukedo yukedo awanu imo yue)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 行けど行けど逢はぬ妹ゆゑ久かたの天の露霜に濡れにけるかも

poems.title: MYS 2399: 赤らびく肌も触れずて (Akarabiku hada mo furezute)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 赤らびく肌も触れずて寝たれども異しき心を吾が思はなくに

poems.title: MYS 2401: 恋ひ死なば恋ひも死ねとや (Koishinaba koi mo shine to ya)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 恋ひ死なば恋ひも死ねとや我妹子が我家の門を過ぎて行くらむ

poems.title: MYS 2414: 恋ふること心遣りかね (Kofuru koto kokoro yarikane)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 恋ふること心遣りかね出で行けば山も川をも知らず来にけり

poems.title: MYS 2425: 山科の木幡の山を (Yamashina no Kohata no yama o)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 山科の木幡の山を馬はあれど徒歩ゆ吾が来し汝を思ひかね

poems.title: MYS 2436: 大船の香取の海に (Ōbune no Katori no umi ni)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 大船の香取の海にいかり下ろし如何なる人か物思はざらむ

poems.title: MYS 2456: ぬば玉の黒髪山の (Nubatama no Kurokamiyama no)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: ぬば玉の黒髪山の山菅に小雨降りしきしくしく思ほゆ

poems.title: MYS 2465: 我が背子に吾が恋ひ居れば (Wa ga seko ni a ga koi oreba)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 我が背子に吾が恋ひ居れば我が屋戸の草さへ思ひうらがれにけり

poems.title: MYS 2469: 山ぢさの白露繁み (Yamajisa no shiratsuyu shigemi)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 山ぢさの白露繁みうらぶるる心を深み吾が恋やまず

poems.title: MYS 2495: たらちねの母が養ふ蚕の (Tarachine no haha ga yashinau ko no)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: たらちねの母が養ふ蚕の繭隠り隠れる妹を見むよしもがも

poems.title: MYS 2862: 山川の水隠に生ふる (Yamagawa no migomori ni ouru)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 山川の水隠に生ふる山菅の止まずも妹が思ほゆるかも

poems.title: MYS 2936: 今は吾は死なむよ我が背 (Ima wa a wa shinamu yo wa ga se)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain.
poems.text: 今は吾は死なむよ我が背恋すれば一夜一日も安けくもなし

poems.title: MYS 3313: 川の瀬の石踏み渡り (Kawa no se no ishi fumiwatari)
poems.author: Kakinomoto no Hitomaro
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: From the Hitomaro Collection (人麻呂歌集); attribution uncertain. 題詞: 柿本朝臣人麿が集の歌に云く
poems.text: 川の瀬の石踏み渡りぬば玉の黒馬の来夜は常にあらぬかも
